Time since baseline is defined as the time between the baseline measurement and the respective consecutive measurement time-point."

```{r}
# global theme for gtsummary
gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal(journal = "lancet")

    tbl_regression(
      add_estimate_to_reference_rows = TRUE,
      intercept = TRUE,
      label = list(
        static99_modified_calc = "Static recidivism risk",
        Aktuelle_Betreuung = "Type of supervision",
        Aktuelle_zusatzliche_Behandlung = "Additional treatment",
        Indexdelikt = "Offense type",
        IoD_reduced_baseline = "Baseline value",
        Zeit_seit_Beginn_Modul_1_in_Jahren = "Time since baseline (years)",
        treatment = "Treatment",
        timepoint = "Timepoint",
        `Timepoint * treatment` = "Timepoint * treatment"
      )
    ) %>%
    modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**", p.value ~ "**p**") %>%
    remove_abbreviation("CI = Confidence Interval") %>%
    modify_abbreviation("CI = Confidence Interval") %>%
    modify_abbreviation("StGB = German penalty law") %>%
    modify_column_alignment(columns = everything(), align = "left") %>%
    modify_table_styling(
        columns = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
        rows = reference_row %in% TRUE,
        missing_symbol = "Ref."
    ) %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ .x %>%
        mutate(label = case_when(
          variable %in% c("timepoint", "timepoint:treatment") ~ str_remove(label, fixed(" (post)")),
          TRUE ~ label
        ))
    ) %>%
    as_gt() %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
          table.font.size = 10,
          quarto.use_bootstrap = FALSE,
          quarto.disable_processing = TRUE,
          data_row.padding = px(1),

  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_footnotes())
```

<!-- SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS -->
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-prim-cares-sensitivity-analysis
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity analysis for primary endpoint Child Sexual Abuse Risk Evaluation Self-Report (CARES total score). The table summarizes the results of a reference-based multiple imputation followed by ANCOVA models for the difference in the CARES compared to baseline. Group differences represent the estimated difference in score change between the intervention and placebo group after completing each module (negative values favour the intervention). Least square means represent the estimated average score for each group at the end of each module, adjusted for baseline scores."

library(gt)

tbl <- rbmi_cares_tab %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    "est" = "Estimate",
    "ci" = "95% CI",
    "pval" = "p",
    "parameter" = "Parameter"
  ) %>%
  # Gruppenspalte verstecken
  cols_hide(columns = group) %>%
  # Row groups über die group Spalte
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 6", rows = group == "Module 6") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 5", rows = group == "Module 5") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 4", rows = group == "Module 4") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 3", rows = group == "Module 3") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 2", rows = group == "Module 2") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 1", rows = group == "Module 1") %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
    table.font.size = 10,
    quarto.use_bootstrap = FALSE,
    quarto.disable_processing = TRUE,
    data_row.padding = px(1),
    summary_row.padding = px(1),
    grand_summary_row.padding = px(1),
    row_group.padding = px(1),
    row_group.border.top.style = "none",
    row_group.border.bottom.style = "none",
    stub.border.style = "none",
    row_group.background.color = "white",
    column_labels.background.color = "white",
    table.background.color = "white"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = parameter) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(est, ci, pval)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(indent = px(15)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = parameter,
      rows = grepl("Least square mean|Group differences", parameter)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = cells_source_notes()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = cells_footnotes()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "all", style = "hidden"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Abbreviations: CI = Confidence Interval."
  )

# save tbl as image
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-cares-sensitivity-analysis.pdf")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-cares-sensitivity-analysis.docx")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-cares-sensitivity-analysis.png")))
```
